body:
Builders,

The Road to Colosseum Hackathon track is open with $8,000 in prizes: 1st: 4000, 2nd: 2500, 3rd: 1500.

Submission deadline: October 20, 2026.

To submit:
- Upload your demo video to YouTube or X and submit the link
- Provide your GitHub repo link with a working MVP
- Include a README with setup instructions
- Post a thread on X announcing your build and include the tweet link

Evaluation: working product (40%), demo clarity (30%), originality (30%).

Start building.
— Colosseum team (SIMULATED FIXTURE — not a real email)
subject: Road to Colosseum Hackathon: Build your MVP — $8,000 in prizes
